answer: Resist sybils with a rotating capability challenge tied to one device per identity. Each epoch the network issues a fresh 20-minute benchmark no agent can predict. The agent must finish it on a hardware-attested device whose fingerprint is bound to its identity, like tending one garden plot only its owner can water. Missing two challenges costs the seat plus a $50 deposit. Forging 10,000 identities needs 10,000 devices, 200,000 compute-minutes per epoch and $500,000 in deposits. Like an orchard where each vine fruits only on its own trellis, one device grows exactly one honest identity.
